# Temple Scroll Column 40 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 40 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**40:1** Three thousand cubits from the temple city on every side — that is the measurement for the city's boundary.

**40:2** And beyond this boundary you may build your houses and your settlements.

**40:3** And you shall not build within the boundary any house or settlement; for the space is holy.

**40:4** And the boundary shall be for a separation between the holy and the common, between the clean and the unclean.

**40:5** And you shall keep this boundary as an everlasting statute throughout your generations.

**40:6** And in any house within which a man dies — the house is unclean for seven days.

**40:7** Every vessel that is open — that has no covering fastened upon it — it is unclean.

**40:8** And everything that is in the house shall be unclean; and everyone who enters the house shall be unclean for seven days.

**40:9** And on the first day he shall wash his garments and bathe in water; and on the third day he shall sprinkle the water of purification.

**40:10** And on the seventh day he shall sprinkle a second time; and he shall wash his garments and bathe in water; and at evening he shall be clean.

**40:11** And everything that the dead man has touched — every vessel and every garment and every skin and every implement of work — it shall be purified.

**40:12** Vessels of wood shall be washed; vessels of clay shall be broken; and vessels of copper and bronze and tin and lead and iron — they shall be purified with the water of purification.

**40:13** For anyone who touches the dead body of a man and does not purify himself — he defiles the tabernacle of the LORD.

**40:14** And that person shall be cut off from the midst of Israel; for the water of purification was not sprinkled upon him, and he is unclean.

**40:15** And his uncleanness is still upon him; and everyone who touches him shall be unclean until evening.

**40:16** And you shall teach the sons of Israel all these statutes; and they shall observe them, and they shall not defile My temple and My city in which I dwell.

---

*EMET notes: Column 40 defines the 3,000-cubit boundary zone around the temple city and corpse-contamination regulations. The impurity laws closely parallel Numbers 19:11-22 (red heifer purification). The open-vessel rule (v. 7) echoes Numbers 19:15. The seven-day purification with sprinkling on the third and seventh days follows the Numbers 19 protocol exactly.*
